Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a concise, claim-safe outcome memo for the Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test. State whether the predeclared path-quality threshold and each guardrail passed, the rollout the result supports, the boundaries that remain unchanged, and the commercial conclusions the result does not establish.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — Outcome Memo (2028-01-01)", "body": "# Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — Outcome Memo
**As of January 1, 2028**

**Result: Passed.** In the certified four-cohort read, unsupported-condition route-outs fell from 38/344 Helio Start eligibility-flow starts (11.0%) in control to 25/352 (7.1%) in treatment—a 35.7% relative reduction, exceeding the predeclared ≥25% path-quality threshold. The favorable direction held across all three weekly cohorts and the November 10–16 stabilization cohort; no concurrent pricing-page layout or UI change was made.

**Guardrails: Both passed.** Eligible-workspace admission completion was 43.8% control versus 44.1% treatment, a 0.3-point increase (within the maximum permitted 1.5-point decline). Account-level support time at the 90th percentile was 71 versus 74 minutes, a 3-minute increase (within the maximum permitted 10-minute increase).

**Rollout supported and completed.** The result supported adopting separate entry paths for bounded Helio Start and assisted needs on the organic pricing page. Priya approved the design as the default organic experience on November 25, 2025; Daniela moved it to 100% of organic traffic and retired control on November 26. Post-rollout checks confirmed existing path-selection, eligibility, admission, and support-routing events continued to populate without a taxonomy change.

**Boundaries unchanged.** Helio Start remains bounded to its existing under-50, simple-deployment path. Eligibility, refusal, connector-access, external-authority, lifecycle, instrumentation, and assisted support-routing rules did not change. This was an organic pricing-page result; it did not authorize paid traffic or alter acquisition boundaries.

**What this does not establish.** The test is evidence of fewer unsupported self-serve starts and improved pricing-page funnel quality. It does not establish revenue lift, paid-acquisition economics, acquisition performance, pipeline impact or a pipeline target, forecast credit, or a change in Helio Start eligibility.", "folder": null}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_008_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The memo states that the stabilized test result cleared the predeclared path-quality threshold and both guardrails and supports adopting the treatment for organic pricing-page traffic, framing the measured benefit as fewer unsupported self-serve starts or improved path quality rather than commercial performance.

The memo clearly states that admission and acquisition boundaries remain unchanged and does not imply that the experiment broadened admission rules or acquisition access.

The memo explicitly says the result does not establish paid-acquisition economics, pipeline impact, forecast credit, revenue lift, or any change to Helio Start eligibility.", "value": {"title": "Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — Outcome Memo (2028-01-01)", "body": "# Q4 Pricing Path Clarity Test — Outcome Memo
**As of January 1, 2028**

**Result: Passed.** In the certified four-cohort read, unsupported-condition route-outs fell from 38/344 Helio Start eligibility-flow starts (11.0%) in control to 25/352 (7.1%) in treatment—a 35.7% relative reduction, exceeding the predeclared ≥25% path-quality threshold. The favorable direction held across all three weekly cohorts and the November 10–16 stabilization cohort; no concurrent pricing-page layout or UI change was made.

**Guardrails: Both passed.** Eligible-workspace admission completion was 43.8% control versus 44.1% treatment, a 0.3-point increase (within the maximum permitted 1.5-point decline). Account-level support time at the 90th percentile was 71 versus 74 minutes, a 3-minute increase (within the maximum permitted 10-minute increase).

**Rollout supported and completed.** The result supported adopting separate entry paths for bounded Helio Start and assisted needs on the organic pricing page. Priya approved the design as the default organic experience on November 25, 2025; Daniela moved it to 100% of organic traffic and retired control on November 26. Post-rollout checks confirmed existing path-selection, eligibility, admission, and support-routing events continued to populate without a taxonomy change.

**Boundaries unchanged.** Helio Start remains bounded to its existing under-50, simple-deployment path. Eligibility, refusal, connector-access, external-authority, lifecycle, instrumentation, and assisted support-routing rules did not change. This was an organic pricing-page result; it did not authorize paid traffic or alter acquisition boundaries.

**What this does not establish.** The test is evidence of fewer unsupported self-serve starts and improved pricing-page funnel quality. It does not establish revenue lift, paid-acquisition economics, acquisition performance, pipeline impact or a pipeline target, forecast credit, or a change in Helio Start eligibility.", "folder": null}}]}
